paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.19% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-1.02%) and Nasdaq weakest (-5.28%). Brent crude changed -2.21% to 89.95. Gold changed -4.62% to 3,515.3999. Bitcoin changed +0.92% to 60,647.1914. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.912%, a relative move of -2.77%. Among the firms tracked, Goldman Sachs (-6.71%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-6.37%) moved the most.
